content: UTF-16 -encoded strings are not allowed to start with a BOM If the value of attribute BaseTypeDirectDefinition . baseTypeEncoding is set to UTF-16 then the value of a DataPrototype (which is effectively representing a string) is not allowed to start with a Byte Order Mark ( BOM ).
